rows.reasoning: In a 2026 interview Hilton said "I want to overturn the legislation that enables that. It's not fair. It's not fair for girls who've worked so hard." That places him on the restrictive side, but repealing the existing law is not the same as stating the rung that would "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth". Nothing in the sources separates that rung from a complete ban, so the row is BLANK direction-only.
